verdict.rationale: n8n documents a dedicated core Webhook trigger node. Independent hands-on use confirms that webhook-initiated tasks run in production, so the core story of an external HTTP request starting a workflow is delivered. However, the evidence pack contains only the docs page title, not its content. Missing for 10: documented detail on custom URL/path configuration, how the request payload is passed into the workflow run, and supported HTTP methods/auth options.

support.subject: As a developer, I can expose a custom webhook URL that receives external HTTP requests and starts a workflow run with the payload
